meta.title: Architecture — Reeds Towers
meta.description: Blooming from the ground: the architectural concept of Reeds Towers — a landscaped plaza, two towers of vertical cylindrical elements and crowns of stepped terraces.

hero.title: Blooming from the ground.
hero.intro: Reeds Towers is conceived as a system that grows from its site. The base is a landscaped public plaza across the 5,050.7 m² plot; from it rise two towers composed of vertical cylindrical elements, which step back at the top into planted terraces.

concept.eyebrow: The concept · Blooming from the ground
concept.title: From the ground to the crown.
paragraphs: The base. The towers occupy a building footprint of 1,786.45 m², or 35.37% of the plot. The remaining 64.63% is given to the public plaza, streets and planting, with retail and cafés at level ±0.00 opening onto Kavaja Street.

The shaft. Each tower is a cluster of vertical cylinders clad in white terrazzo and glass. Dividing the volume turns a height of 191.89 m into a slender silhouette and gives every residential unit a curved façade segment with a loggia. Technical floors 15 and 34 punctuate the shaft of Tower A.

The crown. At the top, the floor plate reduces over seven stepped levels from 630 m² to 41 m², up to level +188.10 m. Each level has its own planted terrace, oriented towards Dajti mountain, the city or the Adriatic.

facade.title: Double-skin façade: terrazzo and structural glazing.
facade.body: The façade has two layers: white ceramic terrazzo cladding and floor-to-ceiling structural glazing. Tall vertical openings bring daylight deep into the plan, while the cylindrical geometry shades the glass through the day.

landscape.title: Continuous planting, from the plaza to the crown.
landscape.body: A continuous planting system runs from the public plaza to the crown terraces: native Mediterranean species, shaded areas, water features and white metal pergolas.

hero.title: Residential units with curved façades and panoramic views.
hero.intro: The plan, built on cylindrical elements, gives every unit a curved glazed façade segment and a loggia. The number of units changes with the floor: from 10 on the lower floors of Tower A to 5 on the upper floors of Tower B.

interiors.title: Curved spaces, daylight, open views.
interiors.body: The living area follows the curve of the façade, with a rounded ceiling and up to 270° of glazing. Bedrooms and bathrooms sit in the inner segments; every unit has an outdoor loggia.

meta.title: Location — Kavaja Street, Tirana

hero.title: Kavaja Street, Tirana.
hero.intro: The 5,050.7 m² plot sits on Rruga e Kavajës, the western axis of the capital, within walking distance of Skanderbeg Square, the Grand Park and the business district.

items.title: Strategic location
items.body: 20 minutes from Tirana International Airport, 40 minutes from the Adriatic coast at Durrës, on the main axis between the centre and the new ring road.

items.title: A growing economy
items.body: Albania is an EU candidate with steady GDP growth and record tourism years. Tirana's residential market still trades below Mediterranean capitals.

items.title: Mediterranean climate
items.body: Over 2,500 hours of sun a year, mild winters and Dajti mountain 15 minutes away.
